paite: Huai laiin Hezekia muanmohin achi a naa. Huchiin Amoz tapa jawlnei Isai a kiangah a honga, a kiangah, Toupan hichiin achi, Na innkuanpihte omdan ding gel sak in; dam khe lou inlah si ding na ngala, chiin. a chi a.
english: In those days was Hezekiah sick and near death. Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, came to him, and said to him, “Thus says Yahweh, ‘Set your house in order, for you will die, and not live.’”

paite: Huchiin Hezekia bang lam ngain a oma, Toupa kiangah a thuma,
english: Then Hezekiah turned his face to the wall and prayed to Yahweh,

paite: Toupa aw, na maa thutak leh lungtang hoihkim pu-a ka omjel dan leh na mitmuha thil hoih ka hih jel dan, hehpihtakin thei gige in, achi a. Huan, Hezekia a kap huphup hi.
english: and said, “Remember now, Yahweh, I beg you, how I have walked before you in truth and with a perfect heart, and have done that which is good in your sight.” Hezekiah wept bitterly.

paite: Huchiin Toupa thu Isai kiangah a hongtung a,
english: Then the word of Yahweh came to Isaiah, saying,

paite: Kuan inla, Hezekia kiangah genin, Toupa, na pu David Pathianin hichiin achi, Na thumna ka jaa, na khituite leng ka mu-a: ngaiin, na damsung nite ah kum sawm le kum nga ka behlap ding.
english: “Go, and tell Hezekiah, ‘Thus says Yahweh, the God of David your father, “I have heard your prayer. I have seen your tears. Behold, I will add fifteen years to your life.

paite: Huan, nang leh hiai khopi Assuria kumpipa akipan ka humbit dinga: hiai khopi ka hum ding hi.
english: I will deliver you and this city out of the hand of the king of Assyria, and I will defend this city.

paite: Huan, Toupan a thil gen a hih ngei ding chih, hiai nanga dingin Toupa akipan chiamtehna ding ahi ding:
english: This shall be the sign to you from Yahweh, that Yahweh will do this thing that he has spoken.

paite: Enin, inlimchiala lim, Ahaz dakbitheihnaa niam kiaksa, inlimchial sawm tanin ka kiksak nawn ding, a chi, chiin, chiin. Huchiin, ni a niamna dakbitheihnaah inlimchial sawm tannin a kik nawnta hi.
english: Behold, I will cause the shadow on the sundial, which has gone down on the sundial of Ahaz with the sun, to return backward ten steps. So the sun returned ten steps on the sundial on which it had gone down.”’”

paite: Juda kumpipa Hezekia china, a dam nawn nunga a laigelh:
english: The writing of Hezekiah king of Judah, when he had been sick, and had recovered of his sickness.

paite: Ka damsung nite sun lai takin han kongpi-ah lut dingin ka kisaa: ka damsung kum omlai dingte suhin ka omta, ka chi hi.
english: I said, “In the middle of my life I go into the gates of Sheol Sheol is the place of the dead. . I am deprived of the residue of my years.”

paite: Toupa, Toupa ngei, mi hing gamah ka mu nawnta kei dinga: khovela omte lakah mihing ka mu nawnta kei ding hi.
english: I said, “I won’t see Yah, Yah in the land of the living. I will see man no more with the inhabitants of the world.

paite: Ka omna suan in a oma, belamchingmi puanin bang in ka kianga kipana lak mang in a omta hi. Puan gan min a puan a jial bangin ka hinna ka jial a; aman siambu akipan a hon teptan mot sina; nang ni khat leh zan khat thil thu-a hon hih tawp maimah ding nei ve ka chi.
english: My dwelling is removed, and is carried away from me like a shepherd’s tent. I have rolled up, like a weaver, my life. He will cut me off from the loom. From day even to night you will make an end of me.

paite: Jingsang tan ka dai teiteia; humpinelkai bang in ka guh tengteng a sutan veka: nang ni khat leh jan khat thil thu-a hon hihtawp mai ding neive.
english: I waited patiently until morning. He breaks all my bones like a lion. From day even to night you will make an end of me.

paite: Lensiam hiam, vakang hiam bangin ka hamhama, vakhu bang in ka thumthuma, tunglam etnain ka mit a vaita hi; Toupa aw, nuaisiah a om kahi, nang ka tang in ding in.
english: I chattered like a swallow or a crane. I moaned like a dove. My eyes weaken looking upward. Lord, I am oppressed. Be my security.”

paite: Bang ka gen de aw? Aman honhoupiha, amah mahin a hih pah ngal: ka hinna ningkitelna jiak in ka damsung kum tengtengin awl khakhain ka pai khiankhian ta ding.
english: What will I say? He has both spoken to me, and himself has done it. I will walk carefully all my years because of the anguish of my soul.

paite: Toupa aw, hichibang thil jiakin mihingte a hing jel uh, huaite kiaah ka kha hinna a om jel hi: huaijiakin hondam sak nawnin hon hihing sak nawn in.
english: Lord, men live by these things; and my spirit finds life in all of them: you restore me, and cause me to live.

paite: Ngaiin, ka lungmuanna dingin ahi, ningkitelna thupitak ka naneih: himahleh nang, ka hinna na it jiak in, siatna kokhuk akipanin na humbitta; ka khelhnate tengteng lah na nunglamah na pai vekta ngala.
english: Behold, for peace I had great anguish, but you have in love for my soul delivered it from the pit of corruption; for you have cast all my sins behind your back.

paite: Hanin lah hon phat thei ngal keia, sihnain leng honpahtawi thei sam kei hi: kokhuka kumten na thutak a lemen theikei uh.
english: For Sheol Sheol is the place of the dead. can’t praise you. Death can’t celebrate you. Those who go down into the pit can’t hope for your truth.

paite: Mihingin, mihing in, amau ngeiin tuni-a ka hih bangin a honphat ding uh: pa in atate kiangah na thutak a theisak ding.
english: The living, the living, he shall praise you, as I do this day. The father shall make known your truth to the children.

paite: Toupa bel hon hondam dingin a mansa gige hi: huaijiakin I damsung tengteng in, Toupa inah, ka late tumgingguineite toh i sa ding.
english: Yahweh will save me. Therefore we will sing my songs with stringed instruments all the days of our life in the house of Yahweh.

paite: Isaiin, Theipi gah lomkhat la henla, damdawi a tata tatte dingin a meimatumah tat hen, huchiin a dam ding, a na chi khinta.Hezekiain leng, Toupa inah ka hoh tou nawn ding chih theihna bang chiamtehna hong om ding ahia? A nachikhinta hi.
english: Now Isaiah had said, “Let them take a cake of figs, and lay it for a poultice on the boil, and he shall recover.”

paite: Hezekiain leng, Toupa inah ka hoh tou nawn ding chih theihna bang chiamtehna hong om ding ahia? A nachikhinta hi.
english: Hezekiah also had said, “What is the sign that I will go up to the house of Yahweh?”
